description: This class defines a filter for verifying the format of Registration messages within the Hono service. It checks for required message properties such as device ID, correlation ID, subject, and reply-to address to ensure message validity.

classes.name: RegistrationMessageFilter
classes.description: A final utility class that provides a static method to verify registration messages' format and required fields.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Checks whether a given registration message contains all required properties like device ID, correlation ID, subject, and reply-to address.
